run_mrp_process_alice: run the alice process defined in msetup.py using mrp.main() with a conda runtime
define_mrp_process_with_conda: define an mrp process named alice with a conda runtime and python dependency
configure_conda_runtime: configure a mrp.Conda runtime with dependencies and a run_command for the process
import_msetup_from_directory: import another msetup.py file from a subdirectory using mrp.import_msetup to chain process definitions
review_msetup_process_definition: review the mrp.process definition for the alice process and its conda runtime configuration
